title: Herr’s Snack Factory Tour

services.name: Factory Tours
services.desc: The Herr's Logo Crewneck Sweatshirt is made from an 80% cotton/20% polyester blend that will keep you warm and comfortable! Available in several stylish colors, each sweatshirt features a Herr's felt applique logo on the front. In 1946, James S. Herr left his family’s chicken farming business to build a snack company out of a vacated tobacco shed. Decades later, Herr's goes on to become the largest privately owned snack food company in the US. A sweet-and-salty classic made with crunchy Herr’s pretzels, creamy layers, and a bright strawberry topping. This easy, crowd-pleasing dessert comes together fast and chills to perfection for any gathering. Plan a fun and flavorful day with the family
